name: fl_sourcemap
description: Offline JavaScript/TypeScript source map resolver. Maps minified tokens, variable names, and line/column offsets back to original source files and source lines from .map files without requiring internet or browser.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'inspect' (list original sources & metadata) or 'resolve' (map specific minified line/col). Defaults to 'inspect'.

map_path.description: Path to the .js.map or source map JSON file.

line.description: Minified line number (1-indexed). Required if action is 'resolve'.

column.description: Minified column number (0-indexed). Optional for 'resolve', defaults to 0.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
